headline: Saurashtra Cement Limited: Updates
sum: Updates - In compliance with the provisions of Regulation 7(2) of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed the disclosure/ s in specified formats as received from Mehta Family Trust (" Acquirer') and…
detail: Updates - In compliance with the provisions of Regulation 7(2) of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed the disclosure/ s in specified formats as received from Mehta Family Trust (" Acquirer') and Mr. Jay Mehta (Promoter / Transferor / Seller ) through Galaxy Technologies Private Limited in Saurashtra Cement Limited ( Target Company/ Company ).The aforesaid indirect acquisition had been undertaken pursuant to the SEBI exemption order dated 14t July 2026 bearing reference number WTM/KCV/CFD/06/2026-27. Copy of Order is attached.
